additional_input.text: Schema-only native contract: subjects/exclude_subjects/exclude_terms lists of strings. formats list ONLINE/PHYSICAL/BOTH required access predicates; exclusive_formats list enum strings explicit ONLY modifier, not boolean, not automatic opposite excluded_formats. excluded_formats list ONLINE/PHYSICAL explicit negative access. availability string AVAILABLE_NOW or REQUESTABLE, notbool; language string literal normalized language. rating/year min/max numeric, corresponding *_exclusive bool. author_text/title_text/exact_text strings: author_text contains normalized author literal, title_text native contains title OR author literal, exact_text native literal title equality or identifier lookup. Canonical subject labels must come from supplied scope. expected_sort separate enum RELEVANCE/RATING/NEWEST/TITLE; no invented object equivalent. Definite absent scalar None/list[]/comparatorflagFalse; missing required scalar UNRESOLVED, notabsent. This is metadata-only type clarification, same supplied to independent author; record message as additional input. No source/prediction/author labels or query-specific hints.

method.judgment_source: Manual independent normative interpretation of every supplied query context against scope capabilities, canonical lists and supplied native scalar contract. Standard library used only for serialization, bookkeeping, validation and hashing.
method.scope_replication: Thirty text-identical semantic bodies occur in five fully read scope contexts. Opaque case IDs were copied for linkage only and never used to choose labels. Capability checks were considered for every context.
method.hard_constraints: Resolved native scalars are retained even when the whole request cannot execute. Missing mandatory values receive UNRESOLVED masks. Partial list values contain only the explicitly settled common subset. Unsupported non-scalar mandatory semantics remain structured.
method.native_title_literal_interpretation: Under the packet convention, quoted author/title field strings are native literal contains operands rather than identity requests. title_text retains the documented title-OR-author match domain; none of these cases explicitly demands strict title-only matching or exact bibliographic identity.
method.sort_default_assumption: RELEVANCE represents no explicit sort override.
method.semantic_remainder_rule: Only the explicitly asserted coastal-navigation topic is a string. Other remainders are null with N/A masks; preferences and unsupported assertions remain structured.
method.uncertainty_policy: Overlapping capability-versus-contradiction precedence in two GLOBAL contexts and token-distance convention are explicitly flagged; no expected class distribution was supplied or targeted.
